rubric.role_summary: Forward Deployed Engineer for federal and national security customers, responsible for technical deployments, field integrations, production troubleshooting, and translating customer needs into engineering priorities.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Forward Deployed Engineer for federal and national security customers, responsible for technical deployments, field integrations, production troubleshooting, and translating customer needs into engineering priorities.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 2+ years of experience in a software engineering or forward deployed engineering role.
- Hands-on coding experience.
- Experience engaging directly with customers on technical requirements.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.
- Active TS/SCI clearance.
- Prior military service, government civilian experience, or work involving communications, signals, cyber, or intelligence.
- Hands-on technical experience with significant customer-facing responsibilities.
- Background in mobile networks, telecom, networking infrastructure, or cybersecurity.
- Experience as an early engineer or operator at a high-growth startup.
- Experience teaching, mentoring, or onboarding technical teammates.
- Track record of taking field-driven feature work into a core product roadmap.
- Technical competency across coding, debugging networking issues, and reasoning about systems-level tradeoffs.
- Experience engaging directly with customers to scope technical requirements and deliver against them end to end.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Arlington, VA / Washington, DC area; New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas. Relocation is offered; candidates outside these areas may qualify with explicit evidence of willingness to relocate. Current residence in the area is not mandatory.
